title: EXTEND_FOOTPRINT_TTL fails with RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED after a config upgrade
pattern: A transaction whose EXTEND_FOOTPRINT_TTL operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (resource_limit_exceeded). From protocol 23 an extension fails only when the entry is larger than the network allows. A config upgrade lowered the maximum contract size to its floor of 2000 bytes; kit2's 5364-byte Wasm is now too large to extend. The maximum goes back two ledgers later.

hazards.placement: a config upgrade that leaves existing code above the maximum contract size
